if (XRAY_USE_LUAJIT)
    add_subdirectory(LuaJIT-proj)
else()
    find_package(Lua51 REQUIRED)
endif()

add_library(sse2neon INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(sse2neon INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

set(ozz_build_tools         OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: skip offline command line tools" FORCE)
set(ozz_build_fbx           OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: skip FBX pipeline (no FBX SDK dependency)")
set(ozz_build_gltf          OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: skip glTF importer")
set(ozz_build_data          OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: skip data regeneration")
set(ozz_build_samples       OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: skip samples")
set(ozz_build_howtos        OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: skip howtos")
set(ozz_build_tests         OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: skip tests")
set(ozz_build_postfix       OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: no per-config postfix")
set(ozz_build_msvc_rt_dll   ON  CACHE BOOL "ozz: use the DLL CRT like the rest of the engine")
set(_xray_prev_shared_libs ${BUILD_SHARED_LIBS})
set(_xray_prev_pic ${CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE})
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
add_subdirectory(ozz-animation EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ${_xray_prev_shared_libs})
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ${_xray_prev_pic})
foreach(_ozz_tgt ozz_base ozz_animation ozz_animation_offline)
    target_compile_options(${_ozz_tgt} PRIVATE ${XRAY_DISABLE_WARNINGS})
endforeach()
if (PROJECT_PLATFORM_ARM OR PROJECT_PLATFORM_ARM64)
    target_compile_definitions(ozz_base PUBLIC "OZZ_SIMD_SSE4_1=")
    target_include_directories(ozz_base PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ozz-sse2neon")
    target_link_libraries(ozz_base PUBLIC sse2neon)
endif()

option(XRAY_USE_SYSTEM_SDL3 "Use an installed SDL3 (3.4 or newer) instead of building Externals/SDL" ON)
if (XRAY_USE_SYSTEM_SDL3)
    find_package(SDL3 3.4 CONFIG QUIET GLOBAL)
endif()
if (SDL3_FOUND)
    message(STATUS "SDL3: system ${SDL3_VERSION} (${SDL3_DIR})")
else()
    # On Windows with BUILD_SHARED_LIBS every engine module is its own DLL. A static SDL3 would be
    # linked into each of them with its own global state, so SDL_Init in xrEngine.dll is invisible
    # to the renderer in xr_3da.exe ("Video subsystem has not been initialized" when loading Vulkan).
    # Build SDL3 as a single DLL there. Elsewhere symbols are shared or the build is static anyway.
    if (WIN32 AND BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
        set(_xray_sdl_shared ON)
        set(_xray_sdl_static OFF)
    else()
        set(_xray_sdl_shared OFF)
        set(_xray_sdl_static ON)
    endif()
    set(SDL_SHARED              ${_xray_sdl_shared} CACHE BOOL "Build SDL3 as shared library" FORCE)
    set(SDL_STATIC              ${_xray_sdl_static} CACHE BOOL "Build SDL3 as static library" FORCE)
    set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY        OFF CACHE BOOL "Skip SDL3 test library")
    set(SDL_INSTALL             OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable SDL3 install rules")
    set(SDL_DISABLE_INSTALL     ON  CACHE BOOL "Disable SDL3 install rules")
    set(SDL_DISABLE_INSTALL_DOCS ON CACHE BOOL "Disable SDL3 docs install")
    add_subdirectory(SDL)
    if (TARGET SDL3-static)
        set_target_properties(SDL3-static PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
    endif()
    if (TARGET SDL3-shared)
        install(FILES $<TARGET_FILE:SDL3-shared> DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}")
    endif()
    if (_xray_sdl_shared)
        message(STATUS "SDL3: building Externals/SDL (shared)")
    else()
        message(STATUS "SDL3: building Externals/SDL (static)")
    endif()
endif()

add_subdirectory(luabind)
add_subdirectory(xrLuaFix)
add_subdirectory(OPCODE)
add_subdirectory(ode)

set(NVRHI_BUILD_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "Build NVRHI as static library")
if (WIN32)
    set(NVRHI_WITH_DX11 ON CACHE BOOL "Enable D3D11 backend")
    set(NVRHI_WITH_DX12 ON CACHE BOOL "Enable D3D12 backend")
    set(NVRHI_WITH_VULKAN ON CACHE BOOL "Enable Vulkan backend")
elseif (APPLE)
    set(NVRHI_WITH_DX11 OFF CACHE BOOL "No D3D11 off-Windows")
    set(NVRHI_WITH_DX12 OFF CACHE BOOL "No D3D12 off-Windows")
    set(NVRHI_WITH_VULKAN OFF CACHE BOOL "macOS renders through Metal" FORCE)
    set(NVRHI_WITH_METAL3 ON CACHE BOOL "Enable native Metal 3 backend" FORCE)
    set(NVRHI_WITH_RTXMU OFF CACHE BOOL "RTXMU only supports D3D12/Vulkan" FORCE)
else()
    set(NVRHI_WITH_DX11 OFF CACHE BOOL "No D3D11 off-Windows")
    set(NVRHI_WITH_DX12 OFF CACHE BOOL "No D3D12 off-Windows")
    set(NVRHI_WITH_VULKAN ON CACHE BOOL "Enable Vulkan backend")
endif()
set(NVRHI_WITH_VALIDATION ON CACHE BOOL "Enable validation layer for development")
set(NVRHI_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable NVRHI install rules")
set(NVRHI_WITH_RTXMU ON CACHE BOOL "Use RTXMU for BLAS suballocation and compaction on D3D12/Vulkan")

# Slang: latest prebuilt package published by OpenXRay/slang (a release only exists once every platform built)
if (WIN32 AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "AMD64|x86_64")
    set(_xray_slang_platform windows-x86_64)
elseif (APPLE)
    if (CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES)
        set(_xray_slang_arch "${CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES}")
    else()
        set(_xray_slang_arch "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}")
    endif()
    if (_xray_slang_arch STREQUAL "arm64")
        set(_xray_slang_platform macos-aarch64)
    elseif (_xray_slang_arch STREQUAL "x86_64")
        set(_xray_slang_platform macos-x86_64)
    endif()
elseif (CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    file(GLOB _xray_musl_loader "/lib/ld-musl-*")
    if (_xray_musl_loader AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "x86_64|AMD64")
        set(_xray_slang_platform linux-musl-x86_64)
    elseif (NOT _xray_musl_loader AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "x86_64|AMD64")
        set(_xray_slang_platform linux-x86_64)
    elseif (NOT _xray_musl_loader AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "aarch64|arm64")
        set(_xray_slang_platform linux-aarch64)
    endif()
elseif (CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES "^(FreeBSD|OpenBSD|NetBSD)$" AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "x86_64|amd64|AMD64")
    string(TOLOWER "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME}-x86_64" _xray_slang_platform)
endif()
if (NOT _xray_slang_platform)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "No OpenXRay/slang package for ${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME} ${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}")
endif()

set(_xray_slang_api_headers "Accept: application/vnd.github+json")
if (DEFINED ENV{GITHUB_TOKEN})
    list(APPEND _xray_slang_api_headers HTTPHEADER "Authorization: Bearer $ENV{GITHUB_TOKEN}")
endif()
file(DOWNLOAD "https://api.github.com/repos/OpenXRay/slang/releases/latest" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/_deps/slang-latest.json"
    HTTPHEADER ${_xray_slang_api_headers} STATUS _xray_slang_status TLS_VERIFY ON)
list(GET _xray_slang_status 0 _xray_slang_status_code)
if (NOT _xray_slang_status_code EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Querying the latest OpenXRay/slang release failed: ${_xray_slang_status}")
endif()
file(READ "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/_deps/slang-latest.json" _xray_slang_release)
string(JSON XRAY_SLANG_PACKAGE_VERSION GET "${_xray_slang_release}" tag_name)

set(_xray_slang_url "https://github.com/OpenXRay/slang/releases/download/${XRAY_SLANG_PACKAGE_VERSION}/slang-${_xray_slang_platform}.zip")
set(XRAY_SLANG_ROOT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/_deps/slang-${XRAY_SLANG_PACKAGE_VERSION}-${_xray_slang_platform}")
if (NOT EXISTS "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}/.complete")
    file(DOWNLOAD "${_xray_slang_url}" "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}.zip" STATUS _xray_slang_status TLS_VERIFY ON)
    list(GET _xray_slang_status 0 _xray_slang_status_code)
    if (NOT _xray_slang_status_code EQUAL 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Downloading ${_xray_slang_url} failed: ${_xray_slang_status}")
    endif()
    file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}")
    file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}.zip" DESTINATION "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}")
    file(REMOVE "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}.zip")
    file(TOUCH "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}/.complete")
endif()
set(XRAY_SLANG_ROOT "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}" CACHE INTERNAL "")
message(STATUS "Slang: package ${XRAY_SLANG_PACKAGE_VERSION} (${_xray_slang_platform})")

find_package(slang CONFIG REQUIRED PATHS "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
set_target_properties(slang::slang PROPERTIES IMPORTED_GLOBAL TRUE)
add_library(slang ALIAS slang::slang)

file(GLOB XRAY_SLANG_RUNTIME_FILES
    "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}/bin/*.dll"
    "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}/lib/*.so*"
    "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}/lib/*.dylib"
)
set(XRAY_SLANG_RUNTIME_FILES ${XRAY_SLANG_RUNTIME_FILES} CACHE INTERNAL "")
if (WIN32)
    install(FILES ${XRAY_SLANG_RUNTIME_FILES} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}")
else()
    install(FILES ${XRAY_SLANG_RUNTIME_FILES} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}")
endif()

if(APPLE AND NVRHI_WITH_METAL3)
    set(NVRHI_METAL_DXC_INCLUDE_DIR "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}/dxc/include/dxc")
    set(NVRHI_METAL_DXC_REFLECTION_INCLUDE_DIR "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}/dxc/include/directx")
    set(NVRHI_METAL_DXC_STUB_INCLUDE_DIR "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}/dxc/include/wsl/stubs")
    set(NVRHI_METAL_DXC_LIBRARY "${XRAY_SLANG_ROOT}/lib/libdxcompiler.dylib")
endif()
add_subdirectory(nvrhi)
if(NOT NVRHI_BUILD_SHARED)
    foreach(nvrhi_backend nvrhi_vk nvrhi_d3d11 nvrhi_d3d12 nvrhi_metal3)
        if(TARGET ${nvrhi_backend})
            target_link_libraries(${nvrhi_backend} PUBLIC nvrhi)
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()
if (TARGET rtxmu AND NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(rtxmu PRIVATE "SHELL:-include string")
endif()

add_compile_options(${XRAY_DISABLE_WARNINGS})

add_subdirectory(imgui-proj)

        "Read the build instructions: https://github.com/OpenXRay/xray-16/wiki"
    )
